meta.title: Open source
meta.description: Soulwick is open source: the game, its online part and this website are all on GitHub. Take a look, grab new versions or join in.

title: Soulwick is open source
lead: Everything you play is out in the open on GitHub: every room, every enemy, every tune. See how Soulwick is made, grab new versions or lend a hand.

game.title: The game
game.text: Dungeon, village, weapons, bosses and music. Every version is here to download, too.

platform.title: Online & website
platform.text: Everything that holds co-op rooms, guilds and leaderboards together, plus this website.

download.title: Download the game
download.text: Every new version shows up under Releases: unzip and play.

bugs.title: Found a bug?
bugs.text: Tell us on GitHub: what happened and how you got there.

build.title: Build with us
build.text: Got an idea for rooms, enemies or translations? Have a look at the project and send us your suggestion.
